--- a/CHANGES.rst
+++ b/CHANGES.rst
@@ -3,6 +3,14 @@
 Version 3.2.0
 -------------
 
+-   ``Response`` recognizes all ``collections.abc.Sequence`` bodies as buffered.
+    Other iterables are streamed even if they have a length. Converting a body
+    to a list closes the original iterable immediately, including when freezing.
+-   Non-bytes response iterable items, ``Response.stream``, and
+    ``Response.automatically_set_content_length`` are deprecated and will be
+    removed in Werkzeug 4.0. Encode text chunks before yielding them, and use
+    ``io.BytesIO`` to build a body incrementally. Single string and bytes bodies
+    remain supported, and content length is still set automatically when possible.
 -   Drop support for Python 3.9 and 3.10. :pr:`3098`
 -   Remove previous deprecated code: :pr:`3099`

@@ -71,6 +71,36 @@ be converted to responses.
     def application(request: Request) -> Response:
         return Response(f"Hello, {request.args.get("name", "World")}!")
 
+Response Bodies
+---------------
+
+Pass a string or bytes to :class:`.Response` for a complete body. Strings are
+encoded as UTF-8. A :class:`collections.abc.Sequence` of bytes, such as a list
+or tuple, is buffered, and its byte length can be calculated automatically.
+Any other iterable is streamed, even if it implements ``__len__``. Generators
+should yield bytes, encoding text before yielding it.
+
+Reading :attr:`.Response.data` can consume a streamed body into a list.
+Conversion closes the original iterable immediately if it provides ``close``;
+callbacks registered with :meth:`.Response.call_on_close` still run when the
+response is closed. :meth:`.Response.freeze` also buffers and closes the original
+body, and sets its content length and ETag.
+
+.. deprecated:: 3.2
+
+    Non-bytes items in a response iterable will not be supported in Werkzeug
+    4.0. Encode text chunks before yielding them. Passing a single string to
+    ``Response`` or ``set_data`` continues to be supported.
+
+    ``Response.stream`` will be removed in Werkzeug 4.0. Write to
+    :class:`io.BytesIO` and pass ``buffer.getvalue()`` to ``Response`` instead.
+
+    ``Response.automatically_set_content_length`` will be removed in Werkzeug
+    4.0. Content length will always be set when possible. Explicit ``True`` and
+    ``False`` values currently warn and retain their behavior; the default
+    ``None`` enables automatic length calculation without a warning.
+
+
 API
 ---

proposal:
Update Response iterable handling and deprecate legacy APIs

Recognize all Sequence bodies as buffered and keep other iterables streamed, even when sized. Close original iterables immediately on conversion. Deprecate nonbytes chunks, Response.stream, and automatically_set_content_length while preserving byte responses and legacy behavior. Add regression tests and update documentation.

Verified offline: 222 tests passed, compileall passed, and git diff --check passed. Independent review passed.

Full suite and documentation build were not run; Ruff and mypy were unavailable. Changes remain in the checkout.
